sprints.description: Land the reckon server, MCP transport, reckon-sync, reckon-create, and the full v7 SPA redesign. Canonical source moves to the reckon repo.
sprints.summary: Shipped 2026-05-26: reckon server (uv run reckon serve), MCP transport (uv run reckon mcp), reckon-sync, reckon-create, and the v7 SPA with 4-tab shell, Cmd-K palette, and reading/graph toggle. All reckon-* skills updated.

sprints.description: Close 7 gaps confirmed in the 2026-05-26 tool evaluation: 5 missing query tools, a list_plans discovery fallback for per-doc repos, and a note-ID collision fix. Add test coverage for the MCP tool layer.
sprints.summary: Closed administratively 2026-07-29: the collapsed MCP query/write surface is in production; remaining field issues are re-scoped into S5/S6 with current evidence.

sprints.theme: Codex compatibility and typed knowledge artifacts

items.why_now: Instruction and skill drift can invalidate every later execution; fix the context substrate first.
items.done_when: Cross-agent entrypoints, target-path doctor and black-box fixtures prove the effective instruction/skill chain.

items.why_now: Physics migration work needs research-before and evidence-after artifacts without fake progress percentages.
items.done_when: Plan/research/evidence schema, MCP, audit and SPA facets land with provenance and migration tests.

items.why_now: Provider model-family names are embedded in persisted state and must be replaced before orchestration hardening.
items.done_when: A provider-neutral capability schema, legacy migration and runtime matcher pass compatibility and risk-escalation tests.

items.why_now: First-class plan, research and evidence types need matching filesystem roots and stable typed identity.
items.done_when: Typed directories, routing and an idempotent mixed-layout migration pass server, MCP, SPA and static-build tests.

items.why_now: The required project index is a version-contention and payload monolith; split it only after typed roots exist.
items.done_when: Separate sprint and project-state resources replace the index with parity, rollback and concurrency evidence.

items.why_now: Portable builds are verified locally; closure waits on distributed sprint state and an explicit distribution name.
items.done_when: Validation-only CI is retained, automatic publishing is removed, project-state migration lands, and the local distribution name is resolved.

items.why_now: Readable MCP responses should target the final typed and distributed resource model rather than reformat the monolith twice.
items.done_when: Layered summary/detail/raw resource responses are smaller, clearer and backwards-compatible.

items.why_now: After the new contracts stabilize, every host-registered repository must migrate or the fleet will retain contradictory state models.
items.done_when: Runtime discovery gives every registered repository a terminal migration-ledger state, recoverable snapshot, fresh audit/build result and typed evidence.

sprints.description: Make agent context verifiable across Codex and Claude, complete the portable build, and separate plans, research and evidence with typed provenance.
sprints.summary: Context compatibility and typed provenance shipped. S5 now establishes neutral capabilities, typed roots, distributed sprint state and concise MCP responses, then migrates every host-registered repository; CI remains local validation only.

items.why_now: Codex needs bounded, resumable, capability-aware execution rather than a Claude-specific fleet assumption.
items.done_when: Bounded sprint operations and a portable execution ledger pass interruption, conflict and worker-failure tests.

items.why_now: Typed evidence enables lifecycle gates without treating research and evidence as incomplete plans.
items.done_when: Lead-approved close/archive/write invariants land with audits and compatibility migration.

items.why_now: Refresh authoring guidance after the type and orchestration contracts are stable.
items.done_when: Canonical examples describe plan, research and evidence authoring on both agent surfaces.

sprints.description: Harden sprint and ship workflows after the context manifest and typed provenance substrate exist.

blockers.summary: reckon-ci-build cannot close until the index monolith has a verified distributed replacement and its locked deprecation decision is reconciled.
blockers.next: Lock distributed-sprint-state storage decisions, ship migration parity, then resolve index-json-fate.
